slides.body: You've been using Claude like a search bar. It's built to do the work with you.

slides.statement: Claude builds the actual thing, live in the chat — a doc, a page, real code.
slides.subtextTop: No more describing what you want in paragraphs.

slides.statement: Give Claude your brand voice and docs once — every new chat already knows it.
slides.subtextTop: No more re-explaining context every time.
slides.subtextBottom: It remembers, so you don't have to.

slides.statement: Drop in a screenshot, a messy reference image, a handwritten note — Claude reads it.
slides.subtextTop: Show it instead of describing it.

slides.statement: For the hard calls — strategy, tradeoffs, planning — Claude reasons step by step, out loud.
slides.subtextTop: Not a guess dressed up as an answer.

slides.statement: Claude doesn't just answer. It goes and does the thing.
slides.subtextTop: Connects to your tools, takes multi-step actions.
slides.subtextBottom: Then reports back what it did.

slides.body: Save this so you actually come back and try each one instead of forgetting by tomorrow.
slides.ctaSub: Follow for more Claude + AI workflow breakdowns
